CSTY.name: Combat Style
CSTY.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/CSTY. The float arrays vary in length: the general array is 2, 8 or 10 floats, the melee one 7 or 8, the close range one 2 or 4, and the flight one 1 to 8. [measured: 144 CSTY records in Skyrim.esm]

CSCR.name: Close Range
CSCR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/CSTY. The duelling circle and fallback multipliers, and the flank distance and stalking time.

CSFL.name: Flight
CSFL.note: The style's flight chances and times, from one to eight floats.

CSGD.name: General
CSGD.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/CSTY. The style's general multipliers. [measured: 8, 32 or 40 bytes in Skyrim.esm]

CSLR.name: Long Range
CSLR.note: The strafe multiplier. The default is 0.2.

CSME.name: Melee
CSME.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/CSTY. The attack, bash and special attack multipliers.

DATA.name: Flags
DATA.note: The style's flags. Exactly one of Dueling or Flanking is always set.

IMGS.name: Image Spaces
IMGS.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/IMGS. [measured: 268 IMGS records in Skyrim.esm; HNAM is 36 bytes, CNAM 12, TNAM 16 and DNAM 16 in all but two]

DNAM.name: Depth Of Field
DNAM.note: The strength, distance and range, and sometimes a fourth float that seems to influence the blur radius and the No Sky flag.

ENAM.name: Unknown
ENAM.note: An alternative to the HNAM, CNAM and TNAM fields, in two records only. It is fourteen floats.

HNAM.name: HDR Parameters
HNAM.note: The high dynamic range parameters: the eye adapt speed, the bloom's blur radius, threshold and scale, the receive bloom threshold, the white point, the sunlight and sky scales, and the eye adapt strength.

TNAM.name: Tint Parameters
TNAM.note: The tint amount and its red, green and blue channels.

INGR.name: Ingredient
INGR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/INGR. An ingredient has a value, a weight, and a list of effects. [measured: 376 EFIT fields in Skyrim.esm, each 12 bytes]

EFIT.name: Effect Item
EFIT.note: The effect's magnitude, area and duration.

ENIT.name: Enchanted Item
ENIT.note: The ingredient's value and its flags: 0x001 = Manual Calc, 0x002 = Food, 0x100 = References Persist.

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: A KYWD record. There is one per KSIZ.

OBND.name: Object Bounds
OBND.note: Always 12 bytes, even when all zero.

VMAD.name: Script Info
VMAD.note: The Papyrus script data. In the main game files it is only used for Briarhearts.

YNAM.name: Pickup Sound
YNAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the item is picked up.

ZNAM.name: Drop Sound
ZNAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the item is dropped.

LSCR.name: Load Screen
LSCR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LSCR. [measured: 298 LSCR records in Skyrim.esm; RNAM is 6 bytes, ONAM 4 and XNAM 12]

CTDA.name: Match Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions under which the screen shows, presumably for the ones that are only somewhat relevant.

DESC.name: Displayed Text
DESC.note: The text shown on the loading screen.

ONAM.name: Rotation Offset Constraints
ONAM.note: The lowest and highest rotation allowed.

RNAM.name: Initial Rotation
RNAM.note: The camera's initial x, y and z rotation.

SNAM.name: Initial Scale
SNAM.note: The camera's initial scale. The typical values are roughly between 0.5 and 2.

XNAM.name: Initial Translation Offset
XNAM.note: The camera's initial x, y and z translation.

LTEX.name: Lighting Texture
LTEX.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LTEX. [measured: HNAM is 2 bytes in every LTEX]

GNAM.name: Grass
GNAM.note: The grass (GRAS). It is not required.

MUST.name: Music Track
MUST.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MUST. [measured: 611 MUST records in Skyrim.esm]

CNAM.name: Track Type
CNAM.note: The track's type: 0x6ED7E048 is a single track, 0xA1A9C4D5 a silent track and 0x23F678C3 a palette.

CTDA.name: Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions under which the track plays.

DNAM.name: Fade Out
DNAM.note: The fade-out in seconds. It appears in the palette tracks only.

FLTV.name: Duration
FLTV.note: The track's duration in seconds. It is only for the silent and palette tracks.

FNAM.name: Cue Points
FNAM.note: The cue points, in seconds. There is an arbitrary number of them.

LNAM.name: Loop Data
LNAM.note: Where the loop begins and ends, in seconds, and how many times it loops.

SNAM.name: Tracks
SNAM.note: The other MUST records this one collects, probably the pre-MUSC collections. A formid of zero separates the layers, since zero is not a valid formid anyway.

PHZD.name: Physics Hazard
PHZD.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/PHZD. [measured: 673 PHZD records in Skyrim.esm; DATA is 24 bytes]

DATA.name: Coordinates
DATA.note: The hazard's x, y and z position and rotation.

NAME.name: Base Hazard
NAME.note: The hazard (HAZD) this one is based on.

XESP.name: Enable Parent
XESP.note: The object to enable the hazard with: a REFR, usually to a STAT, and the flags.

XIS2.name: Marker
XIS2.note: Zero-length; present when the object is ignored by the sandbox. It is not in the shipped .esm files.

XLRL.name: Location
XLRL.note: The location the hazard is in. It is found in the Cutting Room Floor.

XSCL.name: Scale
XSCL.note: The scale of the base model.

RELA.name: Relationship
RELA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/RELA. [measured: 642 RELA records in Skyrim.esm; DATA is 16 bytes]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The parent, the child and their relationship rank.

struct.name: multipliers
struct.note: The offensive, defensive, group offensive, melee equipment, magic equipment, ranged equipment, magic and unarmed multipliers.

struct.name: multipliers
struct.note: The multipliers, two more than the eight-multiplier form.

struct.name: receive_bloom_threshold
struct.note: The threshold at which bloom is received.

struct.name: red
struct.note: The red channel of the tint.

struct.name: green
struct.note: The green channel of the tint.

struct.name: blue
struct.note: The blue channel of the tint.

struct.name: magnitude
struct.note: The effect's magnitude. For the auto-calc the game treats a magnitude below 1 as 1, and a duration of 0 as 10.

struct.name: duration
struct.note: How long the effect lasts. Zero means it is instant.

struct.name: loop_begins
struct.note: Where the loop begins, in seconds.

struct.name: loop_ends
struct.note: Where the loop ends, in seconds.

struct.name: loop_count
struct.note: How many times the track loops.

struct.name: parent
struct.note: The parent NPC. Parent and child here does not necessarily mean a biological relationship; it is a generic way of describing two connected items.

struct.name: rank
struct.note: The relationship level. The stored value runs from 0 to 8, and is converted into a value from -4 to 4, which is what GetRelationshipRank returns: 0 is Lover (4), 1 is Ally (3), 2 is Confidant (2), 3 is Friend (1), 4 is Acquaintance (0), 5 is Rival (-1), 6 is Foe (-2), 7 is Enemy (-3) and 8 is Archnemesis (-4).
